subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should the remaining fix require persisted compaction trigger metadata plus live subagent-yield proof before this issue closes, or is the new main-only usage hardening sufficient once a live canary passes?
rationale: The remaining work crosses overflow policy, transcript schema, and diagnostic attribution; automation cannot choose whether the trigger field is required product behavior or a follow-up observability improvement.

options.title: Require trigger metadata and live proof
options.body: Add a closed compaction trigger/cause field, keep the new context snapshot behavior, and close only after a live subagent-yield wake canary shows no low-context parent compaction.

options.title: Close after live usage-hardening proof
options.body: Treat trigger metadata as a separate follow-up if current main can prove the reported low-context compaction no longer happens in the real wake path.

options.title: Fold into broader compaction policy
options.body: Move the remaining attribution and repeated-compaction policy work under the broader repeated overflow tracker while preserving this issue's reproduction evidence there.

recommendation.title: Require trigger metadata and live proof
recommendation.body: Add a closed compaction trigger/cause field, keep the new context snapshot behavior, and close only after a live subagent-yield wake canary shows no low-context parent compaction.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal combines session usage hardening and subagent requester delivery work, which are the two surfaces the decision crosses.
